answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Each submission hangs on the delta of a task receipt, and the dawn is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the opal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
